routes.name: Visa exemption for holidays
routes.summary: Citizens of countries on Namibia's exemption list can visit for a holiday without a visa. Since 1 April 2025, countries that don't give Namibians the same treatment need a visa.

other: Passport valid at least 6 months beyond your stay with 3 blank pages

Exempt list includes Botswana, Eswatini, Kenya, Malawi, Mauritius, Mozambique, Seychelles, Singapore, South Africa, Tanzania, Zambia and Zimbabwe. The full list was not readable, so check your country on the official page.

stay.note: Up to three months in a calendar year for holidays.

routes.name: Visa on Arrival
routes.summary: Citizens of a list of African and other countries (including the US, UK, Japan and Australia) can apply online for a visa on arrival, up to 90 days.

other: Your country must be on the official visa on arrival list
Passport valid at least 6 months with 3 blank pages
Proof of adequate funds may be asked for
Fees are subject to review and the fee table was hard to read, so confirm the amount on the portal

stay.note: Multiple-entry holiday visa, up to 90 days per calendar year. Extensions at regional immigration offices such as Windhoek, Rundu and Walvis Bay.

steps: Check your country is on the visa on arrival list
Apply and pay online on the eServices portal
Show your approval and documents at the border

routes.name: Namibia e-Visa
routes.summary: If your country is not visa exempt and not on the visa on arrival list, you must get an e-visa online before you travel. The ministry says it is the preferred option for everyone who needs a visa.

other: The e-visa is valid only for the dates stated and doubles as your arrival form
An approval letter alone is not an entry permit

stay.note: Holiday visa of up to 90 days if you meet entry requirements. State the number of days you want.

documents: Passport valid 6+ months with 3 blank pages
Documents in English or officially translated

routes.name: Short-term employment permit (work visa)
routes.summary: Short-term employment permits are applied for online. Other permits, like study or residence, are applied for manually.

other: The official sources I could open don't list requirements, fees or duration. Check with the ministry before relying on this.
